scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/media-storage-links.test.ts tests/storage-api.test.mjs tests/airing-api.test.mjs tests/mcp-connection.test.mjs tests/mcp-file-image.test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply yuexiaji-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:tables:remote: wrangler d1 execute yuexiaji-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;" --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:built: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run db:tables:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc && npm run verify:content-connector
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm test && npm run deploy:built
